summary: Examples of get_url: download with a mode, forcing basic auth, custom headers, sha256 and md5 checksums, checksum from a URL, copying from file://, and username/password auth.
questions: How do I download a config file and set its mode?
How do I download with a checksum URL?
Can get_url copy from a file:// URL?
How do I pass a vaulted password to get_url?

answer_card.title: get_url examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.get_url:
    url: http://example.com/path/file.conf
    dest: /etc/foo.conf
    mode: '0440'
- ansible.builtin.get_url:
    url: http://example.com/path/file.conf
    dest: /etc/foo.conf
    headers: {key1: one, key2: two}
- ansible.builtin.get_url:
    url: http://example.com/path/file.conf
    dest: /etc/foo.conf
    checksum: sha256:http://example.com/path/sha256sum.txt
- ansible.builtin.get_url: {url: file:///tmp/a_file.txt, dest: /tmp/afilecopy.txt}
- ansible.builtin.get_url:
    url: http://example.com/path/file.conf
    dest: /etc/foo.conf
    username: bar
    password: '{{ mysecret }}'
```
